2608.25992.title: ProgRouter: Online Progress-Guided Orchestration for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows under Quality-Cost Tradeoffs
2608.25992.paper_summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflows have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving complex, open-ended tasks through collaborative reasoning among specialized LLM agents, but they incur substantial operating costs due to repeated LLM invocations and long-horizon context accumulation. Existing cascade routing methods make one-shot, query-level decisions and cannot adapt to the dynamic, state-dependent nature of multi-step workflows, in which the right LLM at each step depends on evolving task progress, remaining task difficulty, and cost-efficiency requirements. We present ProgRouter, an online progress-guided routing framework that adaptively selects LLM agents across workflow steps to preserve task-solving quality while adhering to time and cost budgets. ProgRouter introduces a multi-view task progress scorer that combines coarse workflow outcome regimes with fine-grained signals on subtask completion, progress trends, and workflow state quality. Then, a dual-path task progress predictor and an adaptive meta-gating mechanism estimate the progress gain for each candidate routed LLM. ProgRouter makes online step-wise routing decisions that balance progress gain, task time budgets, and long-term operating cost efficiency. Experiments on HumanEval Plus, MBPP, MATH-500, and ASQA, spanning agentic code generation, mathematical reasoning, and retrieval-augmented long-form question answering, demonstrate that ProgRouter reduces the operating cost relative to key baselines while maintaining strong task-solving performance.
2608.25992.paper_summary_zh: 多代理大型語言模型（LLM）工作流程已成為通過專業LLM代理之間的協作推理來解決複雜、開放性任務的強大範式，但由於重複調用LLM和長期上下文積累，這會產生可觀的運行成本。現有的級聯路由方法做出一次性、查詢級別的決策，無法適應多步工作流程的動態、狀態依賴性特徵，在這種情況下，每一步所需的正確LLM取決於不斷演變的任務進展、剩餘任務難度和成本效益要求。我們提出了ProgRouter，一種在線進度引導路由框架，能夠自適應地選擇工作流程步驟中的LLM代理，以保持任務解決質量，同時遵循時間和成本預算。ProgRouter引入了一種多視角任務進度評分器，將粗略的工作流程結果範疇與有關子任務完成、進度趨勢和工作流程狀態質量的細粒度信號相結合。然後，雙路徑任務進度預測器和自適應元閘機制為每個候選路由LLM估算進度增益。ProgRouter進行在線逐步路由決策，平衡進度增益、任務時間預算和長期運行成本效率。在HumanEval Plus、MBPP、MATH-500和ASQA上的實驗，涵蓋了代理代碼生成、數學推理和檢索增強的長篇問題回答，證明了ProgRouter在保持強大任務解決性能的同時，相對於關鍵基準減少了運行成本。
